name: Soham Ratnaparkhi
title: Product Lead @ HydraDB · Backend & Infra Eng.

paragraphs: I'm Soham. I lead product at HydraDB after growing the entire backend and infrastructure from day zero, the same systems that now index 100k+ files a day at sub-200ms search latency.
Currently shipping connectors, hybrid retrieval, and a graph database built from scratch on object storage, targeting ~10x multi-hop speed vs Neo4j.

Hi, I'm Soham Ratnaparkhi. I lead product at HydraDB after building the backend and infrastructure from scratch as a founding engineer. What started as owning every Kafka topic, Temporal workflow, and Kubernetes node became owning product direction for a context graph platform that raised a $6.5M seed.

I care about systems that survive production: hybrid vector and graph retrieval under 200ms, durable ingestion that does not lose work, and a graph database we are building from the ground up on object storage for roughly 10x multi-hop performance vs Neo4j on our agent workloads. IEEE-published researcher, CNCF open-source mentee, and still in the weeds of the code.
